play.lede: Your copy of the game, recompiled for {target}.
play.buildingSub: The game is being built for this computer
play.installRuntimeSub: Builds the game for this computer · a few minutes

status.runtimeUpdate: Update ready, installs when you press Play

install.title: Installation
install.gameFolderHelp: The folder of your Gears of War 3 dump (the one that contains {file}) or its disc image (.iso). You can also drop either here.
install.languageHelp: Language for text and voice audio detected in your game folder.
install.playerHelp: Gamertag displayed in game lobbies, menus, and multiplayer.
install.notADiscImage: That file is not an Xbox 360 disc image, or it is damaged.
install.missingXex: No default.xex in this folder or in the folders right inside it.
install.missingXexInImage: This disc image has no default.xex.
install.invalidXex: default.xex is not a valid Xbox 360 executable.
install.ok: Gears of War 3 · {versionName} edition · Media ID {mediaId}
install.unsupportedVersion: This edition of Gears of War 3 (Media ID {mediaId}) is not supported yet.
install.wrongGame: This is not Gears of War 3 (Title ID {titleId}).
install.runtimeHelp: The game recompiled for this computer. The first time, the launcher builds it from your own copy of the game (a few minutes), and again when the project updates it.
install.runtimeUpdate: A newer build is ready to install.
install.runtimeNoBuild: No runtime build found. Build it with scripts/build.sh.
install.savesHelp: Folder for your campaign checkpoints and profile. Changing it moves your saves there.
install.savesConflict: {folder} already holds saved games. Replace them with your current saves?
install.compilerHelp: The game runs as native code built on this computer from your own copy, so the launcher needs a C++ compiler. It installs one if it is missing.
install.compilerInstallWindows: Install LLVM and Visual Studio Build Tools
install.compilerWaitingApple: Follow Apple's window to install the Command Line Tools. The launcher goes on by itself once they are installed.
install.compilerManual: Or run this in a terminal:
install.compilerManualSteamOS: On a Steam Deck, run it in Konsole in Desktop Mode. sudo asks for the password of the deck user: if it has none yet, set one first with passwd. A SteamOS update removes the compiler, so run it again after each update.
install.runtimeNotBuilt: Not built yet: the first build from your copy of the game takes a few minutes.
install.runtimeUpdateLink: An update is ready: it installs in a few seconds.
install.runtimeUpdateBuild: An update needs the game to be built again: about two minutes.
install.dlcHelp: Add the downloadable content you own (the package files your Xbox 360 downloaded). It goes into your saves folder.

dlcStatus.needsRuntime: Installed · ready once the runtime is updated
dlcStatus.unsupported: Installed, but it could not be prepared with these game files

install.dlcFailed: The package could not be installed: {detail}

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.embryHint: Unlock every achievement to earn the Embry Star.
achievements.hiddenDescription: This achievement will be revealed when you unlock it.
achievements.lockedNoGame: Install the game to see your achievements and your progress towards the Embry Star.
achievements.lockedNoRuntime: Install or update the runtime to read the achievements from your copy of the game.
achievements.lockedUnavailable: The achievements could not be read from the game.
achievements.loading: Reading the achievements from your copy of the game…

online.title: Multiplayer
online.help: Co-op campaign and player-hosted matches, connecting directly between computers. Coming in a later phase of the project.

toast.pick: Mockup: in Tauri this will open the macOS folder picker.
toast.savesNested: Choose a folder that is not inside the current one (or the other way round).
toast.compilerInstallFailed: The compiler could not be installed: {detail}
toast.gpuMissing: The chosen graphics card is not in this computer any more: the game uses the automatic one.

log.title: Game log
log.restarting: Restarting the game to apply the new settings…
log.exitError: The game closed with an error (code {code}).
log.exitSignal: The game was stopped by the system.
log.runtimeMissing: No runtime build found. Build it with scripts/build.sh and try again.
log.savesUnavailable: The saved games folder is not available: {detail}
log.buildNoCompiler: A C++ compiler is needed to build the game: install it in Installation.
log.buildNoKit: This launcher has no kit to build the game with on this system.
log.buildWrongKit: The launcher's kit cannot be used here: {detail}
log.buildUnsupportedGame: Choose a supported copy of the game in Installation first.
log.buildNoSpace: Not enough free space to build the game: {needed} MB needed, {free} MB free.
log.buildStepFailed: Building the game failed while {step}: {summary} (full log: {log})
log.buildBusy: The game is being built already, or it is running.

build.title: Building the game
build.failedTitle: The game could not be built

update.failed: The update could not be installed. Try again later.

saves.title: Saved games
saves.statusHelp: Checks your saved games and repairs the broken checkpoints that make the game warn about corrupted data. A backup is made before repairing or resetting.
saves.repairHelp: Removes incomplete checkpoints so the game no longer warns about corrupted data when it starts.
saves.clean: Reset and start a new campaign
saves.cleanHelp: Backs up your saves and then clears them, so the campaign starts from the beginning.
saves.backupHelp: Copies your current campaign progress and profile.
saves.backupsHelp: The launcher keeps your 10 most recent backups and removes older ones.
saves.detailOk: The game will load your saves as they are.
saves.detailCorrupted: Some checkpoints are incomplete. Repair removes them so the game stops warning about corrupted data.
saves.detailEmpty: The game will start a new campaign.
saves.confirmReset: Your saves will be backed up and cleared, and the campaign will start from the beginning. Continue?
saves.confirmRestore: Your current saves will be replaced with the backup from {date}. Continue?
saves.repairedNone: Nothing to repair: every checkpoint is complete
saves.resetToast: Saves cleared. A backup was made first.

shaders.title: Prepare shaders
shaders.help: Makes the shaders of your earlier sessions before you play, so the game does not have to while you play. It takes a moment and needs the game closed.
shaders.done: {total} pipelines ready. The game starts with them already made.
shaders.empty: No shaders stored yet: they are kept as you play, so play a while and come back.
shaders.failed: The shaders could not be prepared. Open the game log for details.
shaders.newSince: The game has stored new shaders since the last time ({date}): prepare them again.
